# The Saturday Evening Post

> > America's iconic magazine featuring Norman Rockwell art, presidential history, recipes, cultural commentary, and lifestyle content since 1821.

The Saturday Evening Post is a historic American general interest magazine covering diverse topics including presidential history (particularly JFK and the Kennedy legacy), Norman Rockwell's artistic contributions, cooking and baking recipes from celebrity chefs, DIY crafts, travel, environmental issues, entertainment, and reader contests. The publication maintains its legacy of cultural journalism while featuring contemporary lifestyle content.

## Key Topics

- Norman Rockwell
- Presidential History
- JFK and Kennedy Legacy
- 1960s Politics
- Baking and Recipes
- American Culture
- Celebrity Chefs
- Reader Contests
- Environmental Issues
- Film and Entertainment
- DIY Crafts
- Travel
- Holiday Traditions
- Media and Press Freedom
- Historical Archives

## Presidential History & Politics

- [A Surprisingly Popular Presidency](https://www.saturdayeveningpost.com/2013/10/kennedy-perspective-4): JFK's enduring popularity despite policy challenges, by archivist Jeff Nilsson
- [Media Bias Articles](https://www.saturdayeveningpost.com/2013/04/right-to-write): Historical Post editorials on media bias and press freedom from Franklin era
- [Vice Presidents Trivia](https://www.saturdayeveningpost.com/2013/02/vice-presidents-trivia): Odd facts about U.S. vice presidents from Nixon to George Clinton

## Norman Rockwell & Art History

- [Norman Rockwell Crashes the New York Art Scene](https://www.saturdayeveningpost.com/2014/01/crashing-the-art-scene): Norman Rockwell's 1968 gallery debut challenges art critics' perceptions

## Environmental & Social Issues

- [The Looming Water Crisis](https://www.saturdayeveningpost.com/2013/06/water-crisis): Water scarcity crisis at Lake Mead and Great Salt Lake threatens wildlife
- [Tanya Luhrmann: When God Talks Back](https://www.saturdayeveningpost.com/2013/06/tanya-luhrmann): Stanford anthropologist examines Evangelical prayer and religious experience

## Entertainment & Film

- [Speaking Up For the Talkies in 1929: 'Silent Movies Are History'](https://www.saturdayeveningpost.com/2014/04/talkies-change): 1929 article by Wesley Stout on Hollywood's transition from silent films
- [Gary Sinise Rocks for the Troops](https://www.saturdayeveningpost.com/2013/08/gary-sinise): Gary Sinise & Lt. Dan Band perform for troops and wounded veterans
- [Death on the Nile (1978)](https://www.saturdayeveningpost.com/2013/02/death-on-the-nile-1978): Agatha Christie's 1937 serialized mystery adapted to 1978 film by Guillermin

## Recipes & Cooking

- [3-2-1 Pie Dough](https://www.saturdayeveningpost.com/2013/11/3-2-1-pie-dough): Easy pie dough recipe by Andy & Jackie King for sweet and savory pies
- [Curtis Stone's Scrambled Eggs with Smoked Salmon and Chives](https://www.saturdayeveningpost.com/2013/03/curtis-stones-scrambled-eggs-with-smoked-salmon-and-chives): Curtis Stone's quick brunch recipe with eggs, smoked salmon, and chives
- [Emeril Lagasse's Thai-Style Beef Salad](https://www.saturdayeveningpost.com/2013/06/emeril-lagasses-thai-style-beef-salad): Emeril Lagasse's grilled Thai beef salad from 'Emeril at the Grill'
- [Smoothie Recipe: Minty Piña Fresca](https://www.saturdayeveningpost.com/2013/10/smoothie-recipe-minty-pina-fresca): Island-inspired digestive smoothie with pineapple, mint, and coconut water

## Travel & Lifestyle

- [Fiji Vacation](https://www.saturdayeveningpost.com/2013/03/fiji-paradise-found): Fiji travel guide featuring Mamanucas islands and Dolphin Island resort
- [Notes from Scrooge](https://www.saturdayeveningpost.com/2013/12/notes-from-scrooge): Joel Waldfogel's economic critique of holiday gift-giving inefficiency
- [The New No-Car Garage](https://www.saturdayeveningpost.com/2013/05/garage): Humorous essay on garage clutter and domestic life nostalgia

## Optional

- [Christmas Wreath Ornament Tutorial](https://www.saturdayeveningpost.com/2013/10/christmas-wreath-ornament): DIY origami Christmas wreath ornament tutorial for holiday decorating
- [DIY Garden Tiles](https://www.saturdayeveningpost.com/2013/03/diy-garden-tiles): Spring craft tutorial for creating concrete garden tiles with leaf designs
- [Limerick Laughs Contest Winners](https://www.saturdayeveningpost.com/2012/12/limerick-laughs-contest-winners-runnersup): Limerick Laughs Contest winners including Lauretta Ehling from Port Angeles
- [Jan/Feb 2013 Limerick Laughs Contest Winner and Runners-Up](https://www.saturdayeveningpost.com/2013/05/limerick-laughs-contest-winner-and-runners-up-for-janfeb-2013): Patrick Murtha wins Jan/Feb 2013 Limerick Laughs Contest from Saint Marys, KS
